newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish 1996 building permits volume up 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnish 1996 building permits volume up 24 pct.

text.p: The construction volume for which building permits were granted rose 24 percent year-on-year in 1996 to 31.16 million cubic metres, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
Building permits for home construction rose 34 percent year- on-year in 1996 to 25.39 million cubic metres, it said.
In December 1996, the construction volume for which building permits were granted rose some 50 percent year-on-year to 1.6 million cubic metres.
"Exceptionally high number of building permits were granted for construction of recreational houses," SF said, adding that building permits for recreational houses tripled year-on-year in December.
